containers.name: black-owned-frontend
containers.description: Single-page application providing the user interface

containers.name: bw-api
containers.description: Rust web service handling HTTP requests

containers.name: bw_scraper
containers.description: Rust web service handling HTTP requests

containers.name: minio
containers.description: S3-compatible object storage for files and media

components.name: auth-service
components.description: JWT issue/verify (jsonwebtoken RS256). Silently falls back to the committed config/jwt keypair when env key material is absent; issues refresh tokens stored Valkey-only — no DB record.

components.name: jwt-middleware
components.description: JWT verification helper for server-side callers; key resolution includes the committed-keypair fallback.

components.name: auth-middleware
components.description: createAuthMiddleware role-check guard wrapper for protected REST route handlers.

components.name: session-cookie
components.description: Helpers that set/clear the session cookie used by the auth route handlers.

components.name: client-session
components.description: Client-side session-read helper. Consumers (Navigation, BusinessDetail, claim page) each hand-roll their own mount effect — triplicated logic.

components.name: resolvers
components.description: Query/mutation resolvers incl. createBusiness/updateBusiness. Per-operation hand-rolled role checks; envelope {success,data,error} response shape is externally visible.

components.name: login-resolvers
components.description: Login mutation: credential check, JWT pair issue, refresh token stored in Valkey only.

components.name: graphql-client
components.description: Server-side GraphQL fetch helper for internal queries.

components.name: /api/graphql
components.description: POST /api/graphql HTTP entry. Per-request context; no entry-level guard layer — auth is decided per resolver.

components.name: /api/auth/login
components.description: POST /api/auth/login — credential check, JWT issue, cookie set.

components.name: /api/auth/logout
components.description: POST /api/auth/logout — clears cookie; server-side revocation is Valkey-only and lost on cache flush.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header navigation. Sign in/Register are raw <a> anchors (repo convention is next/link); handleSignOut has no error path; reads session via its own mount effect.

components.name: BusinessDetail
components.description: Business detail view component; own session-read mount effect + GraphQL fetches.

components.name: /business/claim
components.description: /business/claim flow page; own session-read mount effect.

components.name: /admin
components.description: Admin dashboard page. Access is enforced client-side only via client-session role check — no server-side guard.

components.name: /admin/users
components.description: Admin user-management page. Client-side-only role check.

components.name: /admin/reviews
components.description: Admin review-moderation page. Client-side-only role check.

components.name: /admin/scrape
components.description: Admin scrape-jobs page. Client-side-only role check.

components.name: /admin/businesses/[id]/content
components.description: Admin business-content editor page. Client-side-only role check.

components.name: business-repository
components.description: Postgres data access for businesses (read/write, claim, views).

components.name: user-management-repository
components.description: Postgres data access for the admin user-management surface.

components.name: pending-import-business-repository
components.description: Postgres data access for pending-import businesses. Its jest spec calls real getPool() and fails at baseline without a live database.

components.name: valkey-client
components.description: ioredis client + cache helpers. Also the sole store of refresh tokens today.
